WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.title: Blood of the Kinslayer
WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.descript:
At the start of combat, gain [gold]Vengeance[/gold].
When you would die, prevent it and heal to 30% of your Max HP instead. This can trigger {Charges} times.
WANDIMOD-BLOOD_OF_THE_KINSLAYER.flavor: He has slain his kin and bears the curse of the undying. Death itself refuses him.
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.title: Undying Royal Blood
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.description:
At the start of combat, gain [gold]Vengeance[/gold]. At the start of each turn, gain 1 additional [gold]Vengeance[/gold]. [gold]Conquer all lands![/gold] cards added to your hand are Upgraded.
When you would die, prevent it and heal to 30% of your Max HP instead. This can trigger {Charges} times.
WANDIMOD-UNDYING_ROYAL_BLOOD.flavor: Death itself has become his weapon. The throne of ruin awaits its king.
WANDIMOD-BLOODIED_SPEARHEAD.title: Bloodied Spearhead
WANDIMOD-BLOODIED_SPEARHEAD.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Vengeance[/gold], deal 1 damage to all enemies.
WANDIMOD-BLOODIED_SPEARHEAD.flavor: The blood on the spearhead never dries. Every drop is added to his ledger.
WANDIMOD-BLOODBURN_EMBLEM.title: Bloodburn Emblem
WANDIMOD-BLOODBURN_EMBLEM.flavor: An emblem forged with blood as fuel. Whoever wears it never fears the burning.
WANDIMOD-ALTAR_OF_VENGEANCE.title: Altar of Vengeance
WANDIMOD-ALTAR_OF_VENGEANCE.description: When an enemy dies, heal for 2% of your Max HP.
WANDIMOD-ALTAR_OF_VENGEANCE.flavor: The altar accepts only one offering: the death of his enemies.
WANDIMOD-CRIMSON_SIGIL.title: Crimson Sigil
WANDIMOD-CRIMSON_SIGIL.description: At the start of combat, add a [gold]Conquer All Lands[/gold] to your hand.
WANDIMOD-CRIMSON_SIGIL.flavor: The seal is pressed in his own blood. The pact has but one clause: pay first, then power.
